gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: She waited at the restaurant for an hour, but he had stood her ___ again.
gaps.explanation: 'Stand somebody up' = fail to keep an arranged meeting.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.
